title: The Assassination of John F. Kennedy Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Please bring water and wear comfortable shoes
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We begin with two lives; John F. Kennedy and Lee Harvey Oswald. They were drawn together by fate, ambition, and forces still debated today.

Next you’ll examine the crime scene on Elm Street, exactly where it all happened. 

Using modern forensic science and eyewitness testimony you'll begin to understand the most important homicide of the 20th century.

As the story continues, the tragedy widens. Two more lives suddenly and violently taken in the hours and days that follow.

And finally, we explore the many conspiracy theories and the world wide reaction to the President's murder.

This Experience includes descriptions of graphic violence, drug use, smoking, self-harm, and sexual relationships. Parents strongly cautioned.

The past is never dead. It's not even past.

The Sixth Floor Museum is not apart of this Experience.
